assessment_objectives.objective: the required disposition (return, transfer, retention and/or secure destruction) is determined and documented for each category of organizational Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) held, managed or processed by a third-party before its services cease.
organizational Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) designated for return are returned by the third-party.
organizational Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) designated for transfer are transferred to the replacement third-party or internally-managed service.

where organizational Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) are retained by the third-party after cessation of services (e.g., to satisfy legal or regulatory obligations), the retention period, protection requirements and destruction at the end of the period are documented and agreed.

organizational Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) designated for destruction, including copies and backups held by the third-party, are securely destroyed and a written attestation or certificate of destruction is obtained from the third-party.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: within a defined period after cessation of services, and using methods consistent with NIST SP 800-88 media sanitization guidance
